documents.title: Instructions for the transfer of the Russian possessions in North America
documents.institution: United States Department of State, Office of the Historian
documents.publicationCitation: Papers Relating to Foreign Affairs, Accompanying the Annual Message of the President to the Second Session Fortieth Congress, Part I; official transfer correspondence.
documents.notes: The instructions direct Captain Pestchouroff to proceed to formal transfer at Sitka under mutual national salutes, deliver forts and public property and draw up a protocol with the American commissioner. Used together with the independently dated official State Department/NPS chronology for the 18 October 1867 formal ceremony; it does not alter the 20 June legal cession date.

documents.title: Purchase of Alaska, 1867 — formal transfer chronology
documents.institution: United States Department of State, Office of the Historian
documents.publicationCitation: Office of the Historian, Milestones in the History of U.S. Foreign Relations: Purchase of Alaska, 1867.
documents.notes: Official Department of State chronology states that Alaska was formally transferred to the United States on 18 October 1867. Combined with the formal-transfer instructions to verify the ceremony/implementation event separately from legal effectiveness.
